description: This file defines a custom exception class ConfigNotFoundException within the OrangeHRM ORM exception namespace, used to signal missing or misconfigured application configurations.

classes.name: ConfigNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception, used in the OrangeHRM ORM component to indicate configuration-related errors.

methods.name: notInstalled
methods.description: A static method that returns an instance of ConfigNotFoundException with a predefined message indicating the application is not installed.
